name: Charitomenosuchus
sum: Machimosaurid teleosauroid from the Callovian Oxford Clay of England, named in 2020 for 'Steneosaurus' leedsi.
holotype: Andrews (1909) named the species from three specimens; the holotype number is not given in the article consulted.
material: Known from the Oxford Clay Formation of England.
biology: The article consulted gives no information on its biology; the name means 'graceful crocodile'.
author: Johnson et al. 2020

images.caption: Skull figure
